title: Auto Stack
description: Automatically merges nearby dropped items into stacks
body: **AutoStack** is a lightweight Paper 1.21.1 plugin that continuously scans all loaded worlds and merges identical dropped item entities within a configurable radius. Each player can override this with /autostack <radius> , which sets a personal radius, triggers an immediate stack around them, and respects a server defined maximum.All settings including default radius, max radius, and tick interval are adjustable in config.yml.
